name: synth_7letter
description: Synthetic 7-letter validation alphabet (invented letters, no physics family): the seven dlog-independent irreducible letters u, v, 1-u, 1-v, 1+u, 1+v, 1-u*v on the plane (u,v), with a FORMAL Z2xZ2 parity grading on 1+u / 1+v standing in for radical parity on a rationalized chart, and a formal three-channel Steinmann grading (A on the u-family, B on the v-family, C on 1-u*v). Exercises the same cut structure as a 7-letter physical alphabet: a 5-letter first-entry set, a 5-letter last-entry set, the Steinmann adjacent-channel veto, and the parity projection to the even sector. The battery (test_ansatzer.py T4) checks its collapse table with and without the channel block.
_note: First-entry dimension at w1 is 5 by construction (five multiplicatively independent letters in first_entry); the parity target [0,0] keeps only words with an even count of each of opu, opv. The channel tags make the w2 Steinmann count hand-checkable: same-channel FE x LE words = {u,omu}x{u,opu} + {v,omv}x{v,opv} + {omuv}x{omuv} = 4+4+1 = 9.
